name: Agrial (Société coopérative agricole et agro-alimentaire)
note: Normandy agricultural cooperative (SIREN 428611719, nature juridique 6317, Caen) owned by its farmer members — its registry board lists dozens of GAEC/EARL farm holdings as administrateurs; its own site calls it 'A co-operative committed from farmer to consumer'. Private farmer ownership, not state: no state or fund stake.
